svg.text: AQUATRACK3-GPT-CLAUDE_1 / FIELD GUIDE
Save first. Print the committed result.
Source-based instructions • Open the SVG to zoom • Read the full README
01 ORDER TRANSACTION
Lock customer → lock products → recheck
Read current activity, stock and fulfillment-specific prices.
Changed price: roll back, show new total, require review.
Write order, lines, stock and loan movements; commit.
02 PAYMENT / RETURN
Lock customer → recalculate → write → commit
Reject overpayment or returns above current gallons out.
PaymentResult acknowledges the committed reference.
A later refresh failure does not mean payment failed.
03 RECEIPT PREVIEW
80 mm roll • fitted length • wrapped details
The sale commits before receipt loading or printing.
Zoom / Print / Close; no orientation or page navigation.
Retry the saved receipt ID rather than creating a sale again.
04 REPORT PREVIEW
A4 • portrait / landscape • page navigation
Preview and print share a captured document snapshot.
Canceling print changes no business transaction.
Printer drivers and actual paper handling need local tests.
